Recommended LLMs and usage notes:

- GPT-4o / GPT-5 mini: best for natural language understanding and generation in the app.
- Local embeddings: use a lightweight sentence-transformer or OpenAI embeddings (if available) for semantic search.
- Store embeddings in Postgres (pgvector) with vector indexes to enable fast nearest-neighbor queries.
- For SEO, content authority, and AI discoverability work, use the master prompt in `MASTER_SEO_DISCOVERABILITY_PROMPT.md`.

Security & cost notes:
- Avoid sending PII to third-party models unless encrypted and consented.
- Use rate limiting and caching for repeated queries.
